sources.snippet: Urban-Aware SAR U-Net PyTorch implementation of the Urban-Aware U-Net (Zhao et al., 2022) for mapping floods in urban areas from Sentinel-1 intensity and coherence, trained on UrbanSARFloods. The probabilistic urban masks the model needs are produced with SPUM.

sources.title: Urban-Aware U-Net for Large-Scale Urban Flood Mapping Using ...
sources.snippet: Moreover, the high potential of deep convolutional neural networks for advancing SAR-based flood mapping is widely acknowledged. Therefore, we introduce an urban-aware U-Net model using dual-polarization Sentinel-1 multitemporal intensity and coherence data to map the extent of flooding in urban environments.
